# DebtDrone CLI

> DebtDrone is an open-source technical-debt scanner with an interactive TUI, a headless CLI for automation, and a reusable Go scanner API.

The current CLI does not expose an MCP server. Agents should invoke the headless CLI with an explicit repository path and consume JSON from stdout while treating stderr as a separate warning channel.

## Start here

- [Documentation overview](https://cli.debtdrone.net/): Choose the workflow that matches local exploration, CI automation, agent usage, or Go integration.
- [Install the CLI](https://cli.debtdrone.net/installation/): Install a release and verify the binary.
- [Run your first scan](https://cli.debtdrone.net/quickstart/): Complete a predictable local scan without optional security tooling.

## Automation and agents

- [Command reference](https://cli.debtdrone.net/command-reference/): Current commands, flags, output, and exit behavior.
- [Run scans in CI/CD](https://cli.debtdrone.net/headless-usage/): JSON output, quality gates, and automation guidance.
- [MCP and agents](https://cli.debtdrone.net/mcp-and-agents/): Supported agent integration today and the current MCP boundary.
- [Troubleshooting](https://cli.debtdrone.net/troubleshooting/): Common installation, scan, output, and analyzer failures.

## Architecture and contribution

- [System architecture](https://cli.debtdrone.net/architecture/): Scanner data flow and package boundaries.
- [Scanner ownership](https://cli.debtdrone.net/ownership/): Open-source scanner and SaaS responsibility boundary.
- [Coverage for Go consumers](https://cli.debtdrone.net/scanner-coverage/): Opt-in coverage execution through the reusable scanner API.
- [Contributing](https://cli.debtdrone.net/contributing/): Build, test, documentation, and contribution guidance.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/endrilickollari/debtdrone-cli): DebtDrone CLI source, releases, issues, and pull requests.
